༄༅/ /zab don thugs kyi snying po'i sgrub thabs dngos grub sgo 'byed kyi shog dril lhan thabs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab don thugs kyi snying po'i sgrub thabs dngos grub sgo 'byed kyi shog dril lhan thabs bzhugs so/ /

dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gter/ /dgos 'dod char 'bebs rin po che/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ / phyi rabs don du lab sgron ngas/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ /dbyer med gcig tu sgrub pa'i thabs/ /sgrub thabs dngos grub sgo 'byed la/ /man ngag yig chung bkol ba ni/ /gsang sgrub ga 'u'i 'khor lo bri/ /bri ba'i rdzas la rnam pa lnga/ /tsan+dan dmar dang sin+dhu ra/ /byang sems dkar po pad+ma'i mtshal/ / chang sbyar 'khor lo 'di bris te/ /pho 'khor mo 'khor rtsibs bzhi la/ /mo 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris/ /phyi rol mu khyud 'bar bas bskor/ /de rgyab thod pa'i ra bas bskor/ /'khor lo'i lte bar a bris la/ /de la bskor ba'i snying po ni/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru ā tsa ra hri ya sid+dhi hūṃ/ rtsibs bzhir ra tsa hri yas bskor/ /rtsibs mchan bzhi la bri ba ni/ /shar lho'i mtshams su bri ba'i sngags/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru a ra che ge mo'i nad gdon bar chad dang dgra bgegs shin+tiṃ ku ye swā hā/ lho nub tu/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru zhes gong dang 'dra'o/ /che ge mo'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor ting 'dzin puṣ+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ nub byang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru a ra tsa hri ya che ge mo'i mi nor lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad ba shaṃ ku ru hūṃ/ byang shar la/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ a ra tsa hri ya che ge mo'i dgra bgegs ma ra ya phaṭa/ mu khyud nang mar oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru a ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dza/ ka ya wa ka tsit+ta āḥyu dzña na sa ma ti ba su puṣ+tiṃ ku ru ye a su tri ba shaṃ ku ru hoḥsarba sid+dhi hūṃ hūṃ dza dza/ rgyal po dang blon po dang*/ mi chen dang che btsun gnyan gsum/ ban sngags bon gsum/ yul 'khor gyi skye bo thams cad dbang du bsdus shig ba shaṃ ku ru hring dza zhes so/ /mu khyud phyi ma la/ ye dhar dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod snyan grags/

bkrag mdangs/ gzi brjid/ zas gos nor tshogs rigs rgyud bu slob 'khor dang mtha' 'dab thams cad shin tu 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig puṣ+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes so/ / pad+ma'i lte bar baṃ bris te/ de la bskor ba'i sngags/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru baṃ ha ri ni sa che ge mo la log par lta ba'i lha 'dre sid+dhi hūṃ/ 'dab ma bzhi la ha ri ni sa bri/ 'dab ma'i mtshams bzhir/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru baṃ ha ri ni sa che ge mo'i nad gdon dgra bgegs bar chad puṣ+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ shar lhor oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru baṃ ha ri ni sa che ge mo'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba longs spyod puṣ+tiṃ ku ru ye oṃ/ lho nub tu/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru baṃ ha ri ni sa che ge mo'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod puṣ+tiṃ ku ru ye oṃ/ nub byang la/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ gu ru baṃ ha ri ni sa che ge mo la log par lta ba lha 'dre mi gsum wa shaṃ ku ru ye ho/ byang shar la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru baṃ ha ri ni sa che ge mo la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ mu khyud nang ma la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru baṃ ha ri ni sa tsit+ta hring hring ka ya wa ka tsit+ta ā yuḥdzña na ba su push+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ a nṛ tri wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ sarba sid+dhi hūṃ hūṃ dza dza/ btsun mo dang yul 'khor gyi bud med kyi rigs thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus la dbang du bsdus shig wa shaṃ ku ru hriṃ dza/ mu khyud phyi ma la/ ye dharma sham bu dang bcas pa bri'o/ /lha 'dre mi gsum bla rdo ni/ /shel la lha yi srog snying a/ /g.yu+u la mi yi srog snying nṛ/ /pha wang lang bur 'dre yi tri/ /sman lnga dri lnga snying po lnga/ /'bru lnga rin chen rnam pa lnga/ /dar sna lnga dang zas sna'i tshogs/ /'khor lo'i lte bar gzhug par bya/ /'khor lo steng 'og kha sbyar te/ /pho 'khor steng la mo 'khor 'og /dar dmar dag gis dril byas

la/ /zangs dmar ga'u'i nang du bcug /ga 'u dar dmar dag gis dril/ /dar skud sna lnga rgya gram bcings/ /me long dbus su bzhag par bya/ /phyi nang mchod pa gtor ma bshams/ /dkyil 'khor thod pa mang po dang*/ /ga 'u dbyer med gyur pa la/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ /'khor lo la sogs rten rdzas rnams/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /dbyer med phag mo sku lnga la/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor bar bsgom/ /rgyas pa mchod 'bum bzhin du bya/ / zla gcig zhag bdun bar du ni/ /thun gtor dus bzhir 'bul bar bya/ / bstod bskul phrin las gsol ba btab/ /bsnyen pa'i yi ge 'bru bcu ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru baṃ ha ri ni sa sid+dhi hūṃ/ smra ba bcad la bzlas par bya/ /bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gnyis ka yi/ /gnas lnga ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /'od zer dmar nag lcags kyu'i tshogs/ /phyogs bcu'i skye 'gro ma lus pa'i/ /bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dpal 'byor dang*/ /bsod nams longs spyod snyan grags dang*/ /tshe dang ye shes ting 'dzin tshogs/ /dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bye brag ji snyed yod pa kun/ /thams cad bsdus nas bdag la bstim/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /thams cad bdag gis thob par bsam/ /de ltar bsnyen pa byas pa yis/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib dag /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ni/ /lus la bde drod 'bar ba dang*/ /ngag la nus pa skye ba dang*/ / sems la rtogs pa 'char ba dang*/ /'bras bu sku gsum thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar bsnyen pa tshar ba dang*/ /sgrub pa'i rim pa 'di lta ste/ /gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba la/ /zla gsum zhag ni nyer gcig tu/ /sgrub pa'i snying po 'di nyid bzla/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru baṃ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dza/ a nri tri wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ sarba sid+dhi pha la nun hūṃ hūṃ dza dza/

bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gnyis ka yi/ / gnas lnga ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /'od zer dmar nag lcags kyu dang*/ / mkha' 'gro dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams ni/ /phyag na lcags kyu zhags pa dang*/ / lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa'i tshogs/ /dpag tu med pa 'phros nas ni/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla na/ /gnas pa'i skye 'gro ma lus pa/ /rang dbang med par bkug nas ni/ /bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam/ /phyag 'tshal gus pas 'dud pa dang*/ /dngos grub 'du zhing bka' la nyan/ /phyogs bcur snyan pa sgrog par bsam/ /rtags ni rtags yig bzhin du yong*/ /de ltar sgrub pa rdzogs pa dang*/ / las la sbyar ba 'di lta ste/ /gsang sngags 'bum phrag gcig la ni/ /sbyin bsreg khri phrag bya bar ni/ /gsang sngags rgyud nas gsungs pas na/ /las sbyor sbyin bsreg bdag gis bya/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag gang byed kyi/ /dus dang kha ni lta phyogs dang*/ /thab dang yaṃ shing brtseg thabs dang*/ /bsreg rdzas me lha'i bskyed chog dang*/ /sngags bzlas sbyin sreg 'bul ba dang*/ /rta nor la sogs gang 'dod pa/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag dmigs pa dang/ /'od zer spro bsdu la sogs pa/ / de rnams bye brag shes par bya/ /zas 'dod pa la zas de bsreg/ 'bru dang rin chen gos dar sogs/ /gang 'dod rdzas de bsreg par bya/ khang bzang 'khor g.yog yul zhing dang*/ /rta nor la sogs gang 'dod pa/ /ming yig byas la bsreg rdzas dang*/ /bsdebs la sbyin sreg dag la 'bul/ /mdor na yid la ci 'dod pa/ /ngag tu smra zhing gsol ba gdab/ /yang yang skyor ba man ngag yin/ / las sbyor gnad kyi man ngag go /zhag ni bdun lnga gsum la sogs/ / ci rigs par ni sbyin sreg 'bul/ /de ltar sbyin sreg tshar ba dang*/ /mchod pa tshogs dang gtor ma 'bul/ /bstod bskul phris las bcol ba dang*/ /gsol ba btab cing dngos grub zhu/ /ga 'u gzhal yas khang du bsam/ /'khor lo la sogs rten rdzas rnams/ /dbyer med khros ma nag mo la/

/dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor bar bsam/ /rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya/ /bkra shis brjod cing mnga' gsol te/ /thums byas rang gi mgul du btags/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ /rtag tu 'bral ba med par bsgom/ /mi yis ma reg ma mthong bya/ / me long rang gi snying gar blan/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams/ / rang gi snying gar thim par bsam/ /me long thod pa chang gis bkru/ /dngos grub dag tu bsam la btung*/ /dngos grub ma lus thob par bsam/ /mchod pa bsdu zhing dkyil 'khor gshegs/ /rdul tshon sbyin sreg thab kha rnams/ /chu bo dag tu bskyal ba 'am/ /nor phyug zhing la btab kyang rung*/ /de nas gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin/ /zhag bya la sogs gsang spyod bya/ /de ltar bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rnams/ /rdzogs nas snang srid thams cad g.yo/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du/ /skye med srog la dbang thob 'gyur/ /'gro ba pho mo bran du 'khol/ /zas nor longs spyod char ltar 'babs/ / snyan grags 'jig rten kun la khyab/ /'gro don phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub/ / dper na yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /rang gzhan kun gyi don rnams ni/ /ji ltar bsam pa de ltar 'grub/ /tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /gsang sngags kun gyi srog shing 'di/ /gsang bas sgrubs shig ma yi bu/ /dngos grub 'byung ngo ma yi bu/ /the tshom med do ma yi bu/ /skal ldan 'ga' re ma gtogs pa/ / skal med rnams la bstan gyur na/ /ye shes mkha' 'gros bka' chad 'ong*/ / dam nyams lag tu song gyur na/ /snang srid lha 'dres chad pa 'ong*/ /snying thig 'di nyid ston pa'i tshe/ /mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs mchod bya/ /bla ma dag la gser zho re/ /maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba bka' rgya yin/ ༈ na mo rin chen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la/ /nor bu sna tshogs tshom bu bkod/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /sgo gsum gus pas 'dod 'bul lags/

/mtha' yas sems can don slad du/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol/ / tshogs chen myur du rdzogs pa dang*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru dhe ba ṭāk+ki ni rat+na maṇ+ḍal la pū dza me gha sa mu ṭa s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ nga yis ji ltar bshad pa bzhin/ /nyams su blangs na dngos grub 'byung*/ /snying la sbos shig ma yi bu/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo dngos grub kun 'byung gi man ngag gzhan la gsang ba'i gdams pa rdzogs so// // ༈ dkyil 'khor ni/ chos 'byung dmar nag me ri can gyi steng du thod pa/ de'i steng du me long*/ sgrub pa'i mchod gtor bla ma yi dam phag mo sde lnga la 'bul/ sa rub pa'i dus dang tho rangs gnyis su/ dgongs gtor re btang*/ de rting sgrub gtor dus bzhir 'bul/ sbyin sreg rdo rje phag mo'i lugs so/ /zhag lnga'am bdun nam gsum la sogs par ci 'grub bya'o/ /bu mo gtsang mas sgrub g.yog byed par gsungs so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)zab don thugs kyi snying po'i sgrubs thabs dngos grub sgo 'byed kyi shog dril lhan thabs/ - PAGE 38 -- PAGE 37 -- PAGE 32 -
